input.command: cd "frontend" && node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require('node:sqlite');const p=require('path').join(process.cwd(),'..','backend','data','memory.db');const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.log('NO DB FILE at',p);process.exit(0)}const db=new DatabaseSync(p);try{const t=db.prepare(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\").all().map(r=>r.name);console.log('tables:',t.join(','));if(t.includes('catalogue')){const n=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM catalogue').get();console.log('catalogue rows:',n.c);const sample=db.prepare('SELECT item_name,category,unit,shop_price,stock_qty FROM catalogue LIMIT 3').all();console.log('sample:',JSON.stringify(sample))}}finally{db.close()}"
